title: No More Sinking
description: Prevents you from sinking into powder snow by making them solid blocks.
body:
Did you ever think that changing your fully enchanted diamond boots for leather ones just to get across a snowy mountain is actually annoying?

Well, this lightweight mod prevents you from sinking into powder snow by making them solid blocks.

Just keep on exploring instead of fighting blocks!
